label: Finite interpretations of immanent role realization and personal origin inventory
paraphrase: One bearer supports correct grounded self-content and willing its own good with thin love, but only the source role subsists personally. Two bearers support both opposed origin modes and personal role realization with coincident Word and Love. Two three-bearer profiles witness the full conditions, using Word participation or incompatible passive receptions. A fourth bearer can be generated by the Word while the rest of the inventory holds. These finite interpretations test the stated interfaces.
